text_block_list.text:
Ruling the world's seas is certainly no easy task.
However—

Conquering “all the seas across the nation”
is no ordinary feat.
Yet Tap Dance City...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Six crowns!!
We actually did it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: The Spring Senior Triple Crown in my right hand, and the Autumn Senior Triple Crown in my left! All the treasures of this country belong to me!
choice_data_list: Yeah, a complete and total sweep!

text_block_list.text:
A sweep of the Spring and Autumn Senior Triple Crowns.
In other words, Tap Dance City is...

Victories across the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen,
Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup,
and Arima Kinen—claiming them all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, today's the ceremony! I wonder
what kind of feast is waiting for me!

And—at the ceremony venue.
What awaited Tap Dance City was not lavish cuisine, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! A flower lei, is it?
Quite a stylish gift, I must say.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: How's this, Trainer? Does it suit me?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just dance a tropical dance for you!
Just like this!

Tap Dance City surf-dances with high spirits.
She seems to be having fun for a while, but...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Uhm, moving on, we will have greetings from our guest of honor.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*, I'm so bored...
Man, I'm hungry...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Don't you think this bouquet might actually taste pretty good?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I'm just kidding. But people do it all the time, right?
Like biting a gold medal
to check if it's the real deal.
"A flower crown is different from a gold medal." As they went back and forth like that...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's get an interview
from the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I would definitely love to hear
Trainer's thoughts as well.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's a nice touch.
After all, they're the key player who brought me this far.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's right. Listen here, interviewer.
I've got a favor to ask—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Why don't you let me handle that interview?"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Huh, to Tap-san?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna dig deep
and pry every little thing out of 'em!
Things we usually never get to hear.

Carried away by high spirits and pranks.
Once Tap Dance City got like this, there was no stopping her.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then, question one,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What was it you always kept in mind
when dealing with me?

What I've always kept in mind...
Having been asked, I stop to think.

What I was always mindful of
when dealing with Tap Dance City was...
choice_data_list: To make her run with style

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Heh... A "cool" run, huh? I've always wanted to run like that, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: You understood all along, didn't you!
Of course I felt it. I truly believed we had been chasing the ideal that Tap Dance City longed to embody, together.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then here's question two.
How do you feel...
when you're with me?
choice_data_list: Wait, is that really... something you should ask here?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What's the problem? I just want to hear it.
Come on, spit it out.

What kind of feeling was it...?
Like fun, yet also comforting, like home...
I couldn't quite put it into words. In other words...
choice_data_list: It leaves me with a feeling I can't quite put into words...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what's that supposed to mean!
Well, I guess it just means you're that happy.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then—
Last question!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tell me straight up:
what do I mean to you?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"There are plenty of possibilities, right?
Sister and brother, best friends, or perhaps life partners."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"There are plenty of possibilities, right?
Sisters, best friends, or perhaps life partners."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just listening would be boring.
If I can give an exquisite response—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you an unforgettable kiss!
Right here, right now!
(Ooooohh)

The venue buzzes over the lip service.
I decide to think about this seriously.
Tap Dance City was the only one who didn't laugh at my dream of taking on the world, taking it completely seriously.

"And you invited me to 'take on the world.'
It's no exaggeration to say you gave me a whole new life."
Yes, to me, she was—
choice_data_list: —You're more than a god to me.
—You're more than a god to me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Wh... what?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Greater than... a god~?! Are you seriously,
truly thinking something like that?"
I had no intention of exaggerating. Her existence was, quite literally, everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa... If you lift me up on a pedestal like that... I won't even be able to pull off a playful kiss, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If a kiss is no good... then how about this.
In that case, take this—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, hup!!
With that, Tap Dance City took off her flower crown and placed it on me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you've earned the right to wear this.
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This will serve as our vow ring!
Come on everyone, give us your applause, your cheers!
Once more, for the two of us!
(WOOOAAAH!)

Together, the two of them bask in everyone's blessings.
The floral crown commemorating the Spring-Autumn Senior Triple Crown
swayed joyfully amidst the roaring cheers.
